notes.title: The third map is available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Version 0.5 is now available!

What's new:

1) A third map has been added. Another challenge awaits you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40992199/7d0468ba8fdc887572e034026479b0a2ead5b02c.png[/img]

2) Small changes on the second map. 
- Some landmarks have been added to the mines.
- Now you can hear the monster in the ruins, which previously did not make a sound. 
- Also, more light sources have been added to the jail. Now it's harder to get caught by the monster that wanders in there.

3) Bug fixes in the main menu.

4) Other fixes.

Now I'll answer the question, "What's next?"

I'll start getting the game ready for release from early access. All planned updates are done.
As I wrote earlier, all future updates will only depend on the community's interest in the game.

If the game is interesting, I will start working on a four-player mode. Also, I have some ideas for other game modes.

If not, I'll start working on another project.

Write your opinion about the update and your vision for the future of the game in the comments. 

See you soon!

notes.title: Update 0.1.3. Effect for textures and display of item names
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I present to you version 0.1.3, let's talk about the innovations.

What's new: 

1) The keys and hammer have received an effect for the textures, now it will be easier to see them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40992199/3c28aa3ced9ee280f14b283749918deab0301a3f.png[/img]

2) Now, when you look at the active item, its name will be displayed on the screen. 
In the next updates, I will most likely change the font and make the background for the inscription so that it is visible in any light. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40992199/555c90cd2e72cebce431efcd80547662ddce9b3c.png[/img]

3) Some bugs have also been fixed. 

That's all, write your opinion about the update in the comments. And in the next version, I will try to significantly reduce the likelihood of objects falling through the floor. 

See you soon!

notes.title: Update 0.1.2. New parameter in settings, monster sounds, music in the menu
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Version 0.1.2 has been released and let's talk about the innovations. 

What's new:

1) A parameter has been added that is responsible for the smoothness of camera movement. It was initially non-configurable and the value was equal to five. Now you can customize it for yourself. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40992199/5185941837ac503ec9f0fb23de180c235b9443c0.png[/img]

2) Now the monster makes sounds when patrolling, their volume depends on the distance at which it is located from you. This will help you navigate better and improve your gaming experience. 

3) The sound of rain, in the main menu, is replaced by music.

That's all, for today, write your opinion about the update in the comments.

See you soon!

notes.title: Update from version 0.0.9 to 0.1.0, answers to questions and some information
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce that the game has been updated from version 0.0.9 to 0.1.0.

What's new:

1) Added audio settings. 
2) The description of the selected map (there is only one map at the moment) is now displayed in the players room, which will give a little information about what is happening.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40992199/c2bdc8f8680add8d5321b196e129f2ffc328f893.png[/img]

3) In the office, there will now be no problem with opening the table shelf in the middle. 
4) I added an inscription that it is not necessary to make a password for the room that you create (just in case)
5) And other small fixes.

Now I will answer some questions that the players have or may have:

1) Does the game support Mac OS? 

No, the game does not currently support Mac OS and will most likely be supported then the game leaves Early Access.

2) When will the main menu change? 

The appearance of the main menu will be completely redesigned in the future, while I plan to do this after the release of the third map.
But even before that, the appearance of the main menu may change, become more friendly.

3) When will the new map be released?

I will start working on the second map soon, and I plan to release it in November-December.

That's all, with the questions.

Maybe I'll add difficulty levels for the first map in the future. 
And also, I plan to redesign the lighting.

That's it, thank you all for your support and positive reviews.

See you soon!
